split.name: official
split.normalizers_fit: full official Train graphs (3360), shared by all arms

candidate.node_budget: k = max(1, min(n-1, floor(0.65*n))); n=1 keeps the unique node
candidate.generation: BFS from every atom; first k popped atoms
candidate.bfs_tie_break: pynauty canon_label of the coloured atom/bond incidence graph
candidate.diversity: first = BFS from canonical rank 0; then greedy max-min Jaccard distance, canonical tie-break
candidate.disconnected: candidates stay inside one real connected component; below-k coverage is reported, the full graph is never substituted
candidate.features: selected raw atom categorical columns, induced raw bond categorical columns, candidate-local S1/S2/R2 summaries, candidate-local degree/min_ring/in_cycle and candidate graph scalars

selector.input: detached readout_in (post R2 pooling, pre readout) of each candidate
selector.softmax: per original molecule over valid candidates

RANDOM.eval: uniform single-candidate expectation + fixed label-blind index

recipe.checkpoint: best Valid RMSE (ties keep the earlier epoch)

horizon.rule: choose the largest allowed common horizon whose measured three-arm wall cost fits the target; never change it after seeing validation performance

route_reference.note: engineering reference only, not an equivalence test
